name: Retro Hardware Database

families.data: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: The one number at the head of the numbers and models pages.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: An item's or project's name: the h1 of its page. 22px under 560px.

styles.name: prose
styles.sample: GRiD invented the clamshell laptop: the 1982 Compass was the first, and it flew on the Space Shuttle.
styles.usage: An item's summary and notes - what somebody wrote, as against what somebody recorded.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: A list page's h1 and a page's own section headings.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default. Buttons, menu items, panel titles (at 600), empty states. 16px on a coarse pointer for anything that takes focus.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, legends, table headings, the key of a key-value row, small buttons.

styles.name: hint
styles.usage: Chips, hints, a stacked cell's data-label.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: The value in a stat tile.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Every recorded value: the value of a key-value row, table cells, serials, chip markings, sizes, dates, filenames, and what is typed into a form. Tabular by nature.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: Asset tags wherever they appear, counts beside a panel title.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between a label and its control's hint; chip vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips and small buttons; between a label and its control.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gaps between buttons in a bar, table cell padding, chip horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel and card body padding, header padding, the page gutter on a phone.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between panels, between gallery cards, between form rows.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: The page gutter at desktop widths; between a page's heading and its content.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Above the footer; around an empty state.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Bezel swatches, the ends of a ranked bar, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Thumbnails, fieldsets, banners, popovers, stat tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels, gallery cards, item cards, the bottom sheet's top corners.

border.note: Presets may change these two and nothing else about a box's construction.

tokens.name: border-w
tokens.usage: Every rule and box edge. Breadbin sets 2px.

tokens.name: focus-w
tokens.usage: Focus ring width; offset is the same value. Never 0.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: The centred column, on every page and in both navigation layouts; with the side rail it sits in the space to the rail's right.

tokens.name: tap
tokens.usage: Minimum height of anything pressed with a thumb under pointer: coarse - tab bar items, sheet rows, scan.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Default button and input height at body size; 28px for .sm.

tokens.name: thumb-ratio
tokens.usage: Gallery cards, item-card thumbnails, suggestion thumbnails.

note: Scales, type roles and sizes: the same in every preset, except where a preset overrides the radii, border-w and the font families (see the spec, section 6).
